summary: Iteration 23 final release-pass verification against live preview (backend + frontend). Backend: /api/health returns 503 not_ready per contract (staff placeholder), /api/health/live=200, flows.review.ready=true & flows.staff.ready=false with issues=['STAFF_SERVICE_KEY'], commit='unrecorded', configuration.REVIEW_DB_NAME=true / BUILD_COMMIT=false, sms_delivery_verified=false, account_role_verified=false; POST /api/auth/review/login unknown reviewer -> 401 REVIEW_CREDENTIALS_INVALID; malformed body -> 422; GET /api/fonts/ionicons.ttf -> 200 with 389724-byte body (Cloudflare re-encodes content-length, verified by len(body)); /api/customers/search, /api/requests and /api/integrations/deletions gate returns 401 without bearer/integration-key. Shared release-pass suites: tests/shared/test_review_provisioning_cli.py + test_placeholder_configuration.py + test_review_access_isolation.py -> 18 passed in 63s (matches expected 8+2+8; CLI live test started a temporary uvicorn subprocess as designed). Frontend jest: 5 suites / 38 tests passed (reviewAccessScreen.test.tsx + appConfig.test.ts included). Live-preview UI at 390x844: /login shows 'Store reviewer access' link (testID review-access-link) -> /review-access renders title 'Store reviewer access', notice 'Synthetic review environment', reviewer-id-input / reviewer-key-input / review-login-btn / review-back-btn / review-notice testIDs, SIGN IN disabled until id>=3 & key>=20; back button returns to login. All FOUR reviewer roles signed in successfully with the gold 'STORE-REVIEW ENVIRONMENT' banner visible: customer -> '/(tabs)' (Expo Router resolves to '/'), admin -> '/panel' (ADMIN header), billing -> '/panel' (BILLING_EXECUTIVE header), telecaller -> '/telecaller'. One negative attempt (junk 40-char key on store-review-customer) surfaced testID review-login-error='Reviewer ID or access key is incorrect' and stayed on /review-access. No SMS/OTP was ever sent. Reviewer keys were read programmatically from /tmp/yash-private/*.txt, never written to logs/screenshots/report; the key field was left masked (eye toggle never tapped before screenshots). No .env or supervisor changes.

minor.issue: Cloudflare edge re-encodes the response (chunked/gzip) and strips upstream 'content-length: 389724'. Body byte-length still equals 389724 so integrity is verifiable, but strict clients relying on the Content-Length header through the CDN will not see it. Same finding as iteration 22.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web still emits deprecation warnings for shadow* props and props.pointerEvents on this preview. UI renders correctly; consider migrating to boxShadow and style.pointerEvents to silence. Reference: touched files unaffected; global concern only.

action_items: Nothing blocking. Optional: audit react-native-web deprecation warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents) in shared UI files; not exposed by this release pass but seen on the preview console.
critical_code_review_comments: Reviewer sign-in flow (frontend/app/review-access.tsx) correctly gates the SIGN IN button on id>=3 chars AND key>=20 chars, forwards role-specific navigation (telecaller -> /telecaller, admin/billing_executive -> /panel, else /(tabs)) and preserves masked TextInput by default; no info leak through error messages.

Backend /api/health readiness contract behaves exactly as documented for placeholder-aware configuration (STAFF_SERVICE_KEY=SET_IN_PUBLISH_SECRETS -> flows.staff.ready=false, overall status=not_ready -> HTTP 503). External uptime monitors should target /api/health/live (200).

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 iteration23 live-preview endpoint tests + 18/18 shared release-pass tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (5 jest suites / 38 tests + live-preview UI: link, /review-access testIDs, 4 role sign-ins with banner, wrong-key error)
